---
layout: null
permalink: /llms.txt
sitemap:
  exclude: 'yes'
---
{%- comment -%}
Generated to the llms.txt spec (https://llmstxt.org/): an H1, an optional
blockquote summary, then H2 sections of markdown link lists. Built from
site.pages and site.posts the same way sitemap.xml is, so it stays current
without maintenance.

Navigational pages go under "## Optional", which the spec defines as the
section an agent may skip when it needs a shorter context.
{%- endcomment -%}
{%- assign skip = "index.md,404.html,archive.md,tags.md,sitemap.xml,robots.txt,llms.txt" | split: "," -%}
{%- comment -%}
/tags/ holds one generated page per tag, and /docs/ is untracked scratch that
exists locally but never reaches the deployed site. Neither belongs in a
curated index, and including /docs/ would make local and CI output disagree.
{%- endcomment -%}
# {{ site.author.name }}

> {{ site.description | strip_newlines | strip }}

## Pages
{% for p in site.pages -%}
{%- unless skip contains p.name or p.url contains '/tags/' or p.url contains '/docs/' -%}
{%- if p.title -%}
- [{{ p.title }}]({{ p.url | absolute_url }}){% if p.description %}: {{ p.description | strip_html | strip_newlines | strip }}{% endif %}
{% endif -%}
{%- endunless -%}
{%- endfor %}
## Posts
{% for post in site.posts -%}
- [{{ post.title }}]({{ post.url | absolute_url }}){% if post.excerpt %}: {{ post.excerpt | strip_html | strip_newlines | strip | truncate: 160 }}{% endif %}
{% endfor %}
## Optional
- [Archive]({{ '/archive/' | absolute_url }}): Every post in reverse chronological order.
- [Tags]({{ '/tags/' | absolute_url }}): Posts grouped by topic.
- [Feed]({{ '/feed.xml' | absolute_url }}): Atom feed of all posts.
